Notes: Same matching as the personnel file. The Provider must already exist (ingest the personnel file first) and have a Healthcare Provider record (otherwise PROVIDER_NOT_SET_UP). Providers are not limited to the roster's Organization.

Accepted Format: 10 digits with a valid NPI check digit

Notes: Finds the Provider when no Unique ID is given. If Unique ID and NPI identify different Providers: MULTIPLE_MATCHES. If the Provider found by Unique ID has a different NPI: KEY_MISMATCH. At least one of the two Provider keys is required (otherwise NO_KEY_VALUES).

Accepted Format: MF + 9 digits + 3 letters/digits, e.g. MF000702523t0K; the last 3 characters are case-sensitive

Notes: When given, it decides the facility. A Facility NPI or address also given must agree with it (FACILITY_KEY_MISMATCH), unless the facility has none stored. Accepted Format: 10 digits with a valid NPI check digit
Notes: Used when no Facility Unique ID is given: it must match exactly one facility in the roster's Organization scope (several: MULTIPLE_FACILITY_MATCHES; none: FACILITY_NOT_FOUND). Not unique in Salesforce: several facilities can share a group NPI. Ignored on Terminate = All.

Accepted Format: A single street line, e.g. 100 Main St
If Invalid: No facility in scope at this address: row error FACILITY_NOT_FOUND; several: MULTIPLE_FACILITY_MATCHES
Notes: Compared with the first line of the facility's Shipping Street, ignoring case, extra spaces and trailing punctuation; no abbreviation rules ('St' and 'Street' differ). Used to find the facility only when neither facility ID is given. When an ID is given, a different address is a row error FACILITY_KEY_MISMATCH (provisional; may become a warning). A facility with no stored address never matches by address. Ignored on Terminate = All.
